note: Rule-based cross-source association on the committed NASA FIRMS Canada 24h snapshot. Sensor identity for this table is the CSV satellite column (FIRMS-<satellite>), which is a single value in this file, so different sensors do not occur. same_sensor_pairs_within_window counts overlaps the rule leaves unmerged. This is not a score of whether a hotspot was correct, and it is not part of the M3 grid.
